description: Synthetic, answerable cases. Long padding deliberately stresses evidence outside the first 4000 characters. Not a real-world or held-out quality benchmark.

sections.heading: Retention
sections.evidence: Cached responses expire after 1800 seconds.
sections.query: 캐시 답변은 몇 초 뒤 만료되나요?

sections.heading: Failure policy
sections.evidence: When Redis is unavailable, the sample service generates an uncached answer.
sections.query: What happens to an answer when Redis is unavailable?

sections.heading: Invalidation
sections.evidence: Document updates invalidate keys starting with rag: only.
sections.query: 文書更新時に削除するキャッシュキーの接頭辞は何ですか？

sections.heading: Change detection
sections.evidence: A content hash identifies modified documents; timestamps alone are not used.
sections.query: How are changed documents detected?

sections.heading: Publishing
sections.evidence: New vectors must be acknowledged before old vector IDs are deleted.
sections.query: 新しいベクトルと古いベクトルはどの順番で更新しますか？

sections.heading: Repair
sections.evidence: Elasticsearch hashes are checked separately to repair a missing text index without reembedding.
sections.query: 벡터가 있는데 텍스트 인덱스만 없으면 어떻게 복구하나요?

sections.heading: Encoding
sections.evidence: The sample loader reads Markdown documents using UTF-8.
sections.query: ノートを読み込む文字エンコーディングは何ですか？

sections.heading: Read failures
sections.evidence: A failed file read aborts the scan so an unreadable file is not treated as deleted.
sections.query: 읽기 실패한 파일을 삭제된 파일로 오인하지 않으려면?

sections.heading: Attachments
sections.evidence: Images and PDF attachments are not indexed by this sample Markdown loader.
sections.query: Does the sample loader index PDF attachments?

sections.heading: Source selection
sections.evidence: Each selected source has a filename, a section title, and a retrieved chunk.
sections.query: 출처에는 어떤 정보가 포함되나요?

sections.heading: Prompt ordering
sections.evidence: The retrieved chunk is placed before surrounding context in the generation input.
sections.query: Where does the retrieved chunk appear in the generation input?

sections.heading: Missing facts
sections.evidence: When the supplied documents lack the requested fact, the assistant must state that evidence is insufficient.
sections.query: 資料に答えがない場合はどう回答すべきですか？

sections.heading: Schedule
sections.evidence: The fictional backup job runs at 03:30 UTC every day.
sections.query: When does the fictional backup job run?

sections.heading: Retention
sections.evidence: The fictional backup policy retains seven daily snapshots.
sections.query: 架空のバックアップ方針では何日分のスナップショットを保持しますか？

sections.heading: Recovery
sections.evidence: The fictional restore verification marker is RESTORE-CHECK-17.
sections.query: 복구 확인용 마커는 무엇인가요?

sections.heading: Components
sections.evidence: The sample stack separates frontend, API, sync worker, Elasticsearch, and Redis services.
sections.query: サンプル環境はどのサービスに分かれていますか？

sections.heading: Streaming
sections.evidence: The reverse proxy disables response buffering for server-sent events.
sections.query: 스트리밍 프록시에서 응답 버퍼링은 어떻게 설정하나요?

sections.heading: Rollback
sections.evidence: The fictional rollback runbook restores the previously tagged application image.
sections.query: How does the fictional runbook roll back an application deployment?

sections.heading: Answer language
sections.evidence: The requested answer language is one of auto, ko, en, or ja.
sections.query: 답변 언어 설정에는 어떤 값이 있나요?

sections.heading: Cache separation
sections.evidence: The response language is part of the cache key to separate Korean and Japanese answers.
sections.query: How are Korean and Japanese cached answers kept separate?

sections.heading: Cross language
sections.evidence: Cross-language retrieval quality must be measured separately from output language compliance.
sections.query: 多言語検索の品質と出力言語の遵守は同じ評価ですか？

sections.heading: Tag source
sections.evidence: The sample loader extracts hashtag metadata from the initial tag block.
sections.query: Where does the loader obtain tag metadata?

sections.heading: Selection
sections.evidence: An explicit tag query restricts candidate documents before semantic ranking.
sections.query: 明示的なタグ質問では検索候補をいつ絞り込みますか？

sections.heading: Boundary
sections.evidence: A metadata tag filter is not a user authorization boundary.
sections.query: 태그 필터를 사용자 접근 권한으로 봐도 되나요?

sections.heading: Classification
sections.evidence: Standalone versus follow-up classification uses explicit rules in this sample.
sections.query: 独立質問と後続質問の判定は何で行いますか？

sections.heading: Rewrite
sections.evidence: A follow-up query is rewritten using recent conversation context before retrieval.
sections.query: 후속 질문은 검색 전에 어떻게 바뀌나요?

sections.heading: Cache history
sections.evidence: Follow-up cache keys include a hash of the effective conversation history.
sections.query: What extra information belongs in a follow-up cache key?

sections.heading: Recall
sections.evidence: Recall at k counts the fraction of labeled relevant documents found in the first k results.
sections.query: Recall at k는 무엇을 측정하나요?

sections.heading: Rank
sections.evidence: Reciprocal rank is one divided by the rank of the first relevant retrieved document.
sections.query: How is reciprocal rank calculated?

sections.heading: Scope
sections.evidence: Synthetic context-retention checks do not measure real-world answer accuracy.
sections.query: 合成データの根拠保持テストで実回答の正確さも保証できますか？
